resources.string: Launch pieces from the bottom to clear rows and columns.
Preview the target, then release to place
Release to place the piece on the highlighted cells.
No space remains for any piece in the tray.
Row and column clear together! %1$s lines cleared.
No more placements are possible. Start a new run.
Good move. Check the remaining tray pieces.
Look for a row or column clear before the tray locks up.
A new trio is ready. Scan the board carefully.
Resume. Choose the column and launch.
Special block equipped! Ready to launch.
Drag the active piece and line up your launch
The current piece starts in the launch dock. Drag it left or right under the board, release when the preview looks good, and it will drop into the nearest valid lane.
Use action blocks when the board gets crowded
Hold swaps the current piece, Pause freezes the run, Block Properties explains symbols, and Settings changes the look and language. These buttons also follow your chosen board block style.
Special blocks can save tight boards
Some pieces carry special effects. Learn what each icon does so you can clear a row, clear a column, slip through gaps, or punch through danger when the board gets crowded.
You are ready to launch in StackShift
Keep your launches clean, plan for the next queue, and use specials before pressure builds too high. When you want a refresher, come back to this guide anytime.
Open Tutorial anytime to review launching, queue awareness, and special block effects.
Open Settings to change the language, theme, colors, and block style before your next run.
